summary: Add production 32 MiB Japanese and Simplified Chinese support: verified full-game locale imports with FE8U mapping and explicit fallback catalogs, licensed deterministic CJK font assets and a multilingual Huffman codec, UTF-8 language UI with persisted first-start/Config switching, localization host/build/runtime gates, and captured CJK playtest scenarios (see docs/localization.md, docs/game_locale_sources.md, and docs/cjk_fonts.md).
